notes.title: Touhou Ikyouroku ~the Apocryphal Gensoukyou will release on 30th Sept.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541643/940a4a7f4f6813bdb9be42c9f4b5ad2701038c52.jpg

We are pleased to announce that Touhou Ikyouroku ~the Apocryphal Gensoukyou will release on 30th Sept. with a discount price at 12 CNY.

The game includes a prologue and three chapters, as well as an Ending and an epilogue. You can also unlock an additional story. 

YEARS STUDIO is an amateur game production group composed of three people. Due to technical limitations, problems and bugs are inevitable. You can feedback below or try to join QQ Group: 486013938
